style_fidelity.notes: Both nail the painterly stipple, banded planet, three-sun corona, hand-drawn lines. Style discipline is matched.

layout.notes: Ours holds the same composition across long stretches (t=12-22 is one static card; t=28-36 is one static card). Ref rotates composition every 2-3 seconds. Ref uses 'one idea per card' discipline — diagram-only beats (centered sun, centered planet) sit beside stickman-only beats (thinker on a moon) and integrated-diagram beats. Ours packs 5 elements per card across the segment.

type.notes: Ours' ALL CAPS captions + black outlines are good, header band is good, KONACKI 2005 stamp is integrated. Ref's per-beat integrated hand-lettered labels (arrow pointing from header, 'PULLED IN THREE DIRECTIONS' stamped on the diagram) carry the segment. Ours leans on captions where ref puts text ON the subject.

palette.notes: Both segment palettes are disciplined. Ours' yellow/orange/red sun trio + light-blue sky + gray planet matches ref's palette intent. No drift within the segment.

audio_alignment.notes: Both align narration beats to visual cards. Ours' cards hold on the right phrase windows. Ref's tighter snap cuts land closer to the audio phrasing.

character.notes: Ours' stickman is 25-30% of frame on most beats, with a narrow expression range (oval-awed, smirk) and limited pose variety. Ref's stickman is 50-70% of frame, with REAL expression variety (worried thinker hand-to-mouth on the moon, deadpan grim stare in shadow) and pose variety (hands-clasped, hand-to-mouth thinking, full-body shadow stance). Ref's stickman carries the emotional arc; ours is a recurring stamp.

biggest_gap: Composition variety + stickman scale and expression range. Specifically: (1) ours holds one composition across 10s stretches (t=12-22 same small-stickman-plus-gas-giant; t=28-36 same stickman-on-moon), ref rotates between diagram-only, stickman-only, and integrated-diagram every 2-3s; (2) ours' stickman is 25-30% of frame, ref's is 50-70%; (3) ours' stickman uses 2 expressions (oval-awed, smirk) across the read beats, ref uses at least 3 (worried-thinking, deadpan-grim, awed) with distinct poses.
sub_gaps: Integrated hand-lettered labels: ref stamps 'PULLED IN THREE DIRECTIONS' directly on the diagram at t=36, while ours places it in the caption band. Ref's 'arrow-from-header' technique at t=14 (red arrow from 'HD 188753 AB' down to the planet) is a strong integrated move we don't have.
Stickman pose variety: ref shows a 'thinker' pose (hand-to-mouth, on a moon) at t=8 and a full-body shadow stance at t=36 — both convey story emotion. Ours is rigid across beats.

Composition rhythm: ref alternates between stickman-only beats (the moon thinker at t=8), diagram-only beats (centered gas-giant at t=14, centered sun at t=20), and integrated-diagram beats (the three-pull force diagram at t=36). Ours mostly repeats the same 4-5-element composition.

Stickman facial expression range: across the 6 read frames, ours shows only 'oval' (awed) and 'smirk' — same mouth shape repeats. Ref shows worried/thinker, deadpan-grim, awed, with subtle head tilts and brow changes.
Background environment: ref adds landscape (moon surface at t=8 and t=36) to ground the stickman emotionally — he's STANDING on something. Ours' stickman floats against a flat sky with no surface.

round_4_directives: ROTATE COMPOSITION EVERY 2-3 SECONDS: don't hold one card for more than 3 seconds. Cut between stickman-only / planet-only / sun-only / integrated-diagram beats. Ref rotates; ours holds.
SCALE STICKMAN TO 50-70% OF FRAME on emotional beats (not 25-30%). Per CLAUDE.md §6, the stickman must carry the segment emotionally.

EXPAND EXPRESSION RANGE: add at least 4 more distinct expressions beyond oval/smirk — deadpan-grim (downturned mouth, flat brows), worried-thinker (raised brows, hand-near-mouth), awed (wide oval + raised brows), skeptical (one brow raised). Mouth shape is the only thing that changes between expressions.
EMBRACE 'ONE IDEA PER CARD': some beats should be stickman-only (no planet, no caption, no label). Other beats should be diagram-only (no stickman, no caption). Don't cram 5+ elements per card.

INTEGRATE HAND-LETTERED LABELS ON THE DIAGRAM: stamp 'PULLED IN THREE DIRECTIONS' on the force diagram (not in caption band). Add arrows from header to subject (ref's t=14 technique). Labels belong ON the subject.
GROUND THE STICKMAN: when he's the focus, put him on a surface (moon, landscape, planet horizon). Don't float him against a flat sky.

REPLACE THE SPEECH-BUBBLE QUOTE-CARD on the konacki beat with a stickman-only beat — huge stickman (~70%) with deadpan-grim expression, standing on a moon surface, no quote bubble, no caption. The reference achieves more emotion with less.

VARY POSE PER BEAT: not just hands-up and standing. Add thinker (hand-to-mouth), cowering (knees bent, arms in), pointing (one arm out), shrugged (arms out, palms up). Poses should match the beat's emotion.
